subject: y-axis tick breaks in bar plot

messages.author: 0ad5a33f4578e90b
messages.subject: y-axis tick breaks in bar plot
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to customize the y-axis tick marks in a bar plot with no luck. According the the documentation, it seems this should be done through the scale function, but I have been unable to get the 'breaks' or 'labels' arguments to have any effect on the plot. Here is an example:

dta <- data.frame(year=2000:2008,count=c(8,4,5,3,1,0,1,8,7))
qplot(data=dta,x=year, y=count,geom="bar", stat="identity") +
theme_bw() +
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,10),xlim=c(1999,2009)) +
scale_fill_grey(breaks=seq(from=0,to=10,by=2))


What I'm trying to get is the tick mark for "10" to appear labeled at the top of the y-axis.

Thanks very much for your help.

Peter

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: y-axis tick breaks in bar plot
parts:
Hi Peter,

If you want to affect the y axis, you need the y scale:

scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(from=0,to=10,by=2))

Hadley
